# FDG4007

> CONSIDER defining a struct instead of a class if instances of the type are small and commonly short-lived or are commonly embedded in other objects, especially arrays.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 4.2 Choosing Between Class and Struct.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test none
- Status: verified

Choosing between a class and a struct depends on how instances are used; not machine-checkable.
